Priya's the real signal here, and it's actually two problems, not one: the backlog being stressful, and her saying she doesn't feel heard when she raises it. That second part matters as much as the first — if she's brought this up before and it didn't land, that's worth someone following up with her directly, not just filing it as "known issue, noted."

Riley saying it's fine doesn't offset that — it's his experience, not a counterpoint to hers. Both can be true at once.

Marcus not saying much — I've got nothing to read into that beyond the fact of it. Could be nothing. Worth someone just checking he's good, not assuming the silence means either way.

So no, I wouldn't sum this up as "team's mostly fine." The thing that actually needs attention is Priya's second point — not the backlog itself, whether she's being heard about it.
